Bill.BriefDescription: Retroactively applying certain intermediate license law amendments made during the 2009 legislative session.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to retroactively applying certain intermediatelicense law amendments made during the 2009 legislative session; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Section 1, chapter 125, Laws of 2009 appliesretroactively to July 1, 2001, the effective date of chapter 115, Lawsof 2000, as well as prospectively.
